about: compiler/ergobuild: cgo-free static ergo tool command construction, CGO_ENABLED stripping, reproducible flags, and SoA CommandTable (SELFHOST-TASK-PROFMD-SIZES).

mutants.name: selfhost-ergobuild-env-strips-cgo
mutants.rule: Env must strip any pre-existing CGO_ENABLED= entry before appending CGO_ENABLED=0.

mutants.name: selfhost-ergobuild-reproducible-flags
mutants.rule: BuildFlags must include both -trimpath and -buildvcs=false for reproducible builds.

mutants.name: selfhost-ergobuild-table-env-slice
mutants.rule: AddCommand must record the exact environment slice length in CommandTable.EnvLen.
